title: Ten Indians just joined a 246-year-old American academy in the same year
sources: American Academy of Arts and Sciences, April 22, 2026 - 2026 New Member Announcement
India Tribune, 2026 - Indian diaspora leaders honored in the 2026 class of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences
caption:
Ten Indians. One 246-year-old American academy. Same year.

The American Academy of Arts and Sciences - founded in 1780, whose past members include Einstein, Darwin and 250+ Nobel laureates - named its 2026 class of new members on April 22. Among the 252 leaders elected: ten are Indian-origin professionals living and working in the US, including former White House science chief Arati Prabhakar, former Infosys CEO Vishal Sikka and Girls Who Code founder Reshma Saujani. Separately, theoretical physicist Ashoke Sen was elected an International Honorary Member representing India, one of only a handful chosen from 14 countries worldwide. Formal induction happens in Cambridge, MA in October 2026.

Every Indian name in a room like this is soft power India didn't have to build alone - it walked in wearing someone else's passport.

Sources: American Academy of Arts and Sciences, India Tribune (2026)
